authorization.source: user confirmation in the continuing PR #247 task
authorization.scope: 标题和摘要明确表明为单一应用报告、重复评测或观点总结，且没有新的可独立复现算法或公开基准时，可按本轮不收录结案。

required_evidence: fixed arXiv identity and observed revision
pinned original metadata capture and fingerprint
positive genre or contribution evidence and an individual reason
original_source_priority: possible production A/B or full-traffic evidence
does_not_authorize: rejecting original algorithms or new public benchmarks merely for low priority
treating an absent code or A/B keyword as proof of ineligibility
marking an unread in-scope paper as high cost
claiming title/abstract screening is full-text review or implementation
automatically implementing, training, retrying, merging or deploying
full_experiment_cost_rule: Original-source-supported high-cost non-reproduction is review DONE and non-blocking.
